# ReconfigurableSNN_Accelerator

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A hardware accelerator for spiking neural networks that supports runtime reconfiguration of both neuron parameters and synaptic connectivity patterns. It bridges the gap between static ASIC designs and flexible software simulations, enabling adaptive neuromorphic processing in real-time.
